description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate EmployeeSkill entities by setting associated Employee and Skill objects based on their IDs. It acts as a decorator to enhance the functionality of EmployeeSkill objects within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeSkill entities, providing methods to set associated Employee and Skill objects via their IDs using entity references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSkill object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the EmployeeSkill based on the employee's number.

methods.name: setSkillBySkillId
methods.description: Sets the Skill associated with the EmployeeSkill based on the skill's ID.
